# DumpSock

Cloudless iPhone backup. Pull your data off your phone with no third-party cloud in the path.

## Where to read more

- [dumpsock.hartle.tech](https://dumpsock.hartle.tech) — landing + docs
- [github.com/code-hartle-tech/dumpsock](https://github.com/code-hartle-tech/dumpsock) — source

## Why it exists

Apple's backup story is iCloud-or-encrypted-iTunes. iCloud trades privacy for convenience; iTunes encrypted backups are opaque if you ever lose the password. DumpSock is the third path: local, scriptable, your-data-your-socket.
